questions.question: Which of the following months was celebrated as 'Nutrition Month' in India in the year 2020?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**September.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nutrition Month:**__

 
 
• It was celebrated to **promote nutrition among Women and Children.**
 
• It is also called** Rashtriya Poshan Maah.**
 
• **Rashtriya Poshan Maah** was celebrated in** September 2020.**
 
• **Poshan Maah** is celebrated every year to encourage **Jan Bhagidaari** in order to ensure health and nutrition for everyone. Every year Poshan Maah is celebrated all over the country under POSHAN Abhiyaan, launched in 2018.
 
• The importance of Nutrition in our lives was emphasized by** Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi** in his popular programme** "Mann ki Baat on 30th August 2020.**
 
• **PM Narendra Modi announced to celebrate September as a month of nutrition.**
 
• In his **Mann Ki Baat programme**, he laid emphasis on creating awareness to **fight malnutrition among children, particularly the girl child.**
 
• **Gujarat Government** launched a pilot project, **Poshan Abhiyan**, last year, which is a statewide mission to eradicate malnutrition among children.

questions.question: Where was the first factory of the Indian Iron and Steel Company (IISCO) set up?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Hirapur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Iron and Steel Company (IISCO)**

 
 
• IISCO is an integrated steel plant located at **Burnpur (now).**
 
• It is a steel plant that is a part of the **Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL).**
 
• It was established in **1918 as an Indian Iron and Steel Company** under the flagship of the **Martin Burn group.**
 
• It was amalgamated with **SAIL in 2006** and renamed **IISCO Steel Plant.**
 
• It has a crude steel production capacity of **2.5 million tonnes per year.**
 
• SAIL is India's **3rd and the world's 20th largest steel-producing company** with an annual production of **16.30 million metric tons respectively.​**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **IISCO **produced iron from an open-top blast furnace at **Hirapur (later to be called Burnpur)** in West Bengal for the first time in 1922.
 
• This full-fledged integrated steel plant is one of India’s oldest.
 
• The plant manufactures a range of products, over some of which it holds exclusive market dominance.
 
• **Iron and steel produced **by it have been acknowledged as being of the **finest quality. **

• **Oxalic acids**__
 __
 
• Many leafy green plants contain oxalic acid.
 
• **Oxalate** is another name of oxalic acid. •
 
• The essential nutrients like calcium and iron are absorbed by oxalic acid.
 
• In plants and plant-based foods, the concentration of oxalic acid is low.
 
• Oxalic acid is an **organic compound.**

• It is a highly **corrosive mineral acid.**
 
• The pure compound is colourless.

questions.question: Which of the following types of computer is used in climate research and weather forecasting?

__
 
• **Supercomputers**__

 __
 
• A Supercomputer would be** used for weather forecasting.**
 
• **Supercomputers **are used to** forecast climate research, molecular modelling, and oil and gas exploration.**
 
• **Meteorologists** use them to do research on the atmosphere and worldwide temperature variation.
 
• Scientists use them for sub-atomic demonstrating, which gives them the opportunity to figure out the structures and properties of natural composites.
 
• They are also used to figure out the impact of wind and turbulence on a plane.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mini Computers**__

 __
 
• They are **smaller in size, faster, cost lower than mainframe computers.**
 
• Minicomputers are IBM-17, DEC PDP-11, HP-9000, etc.
 
 
 
• **Microcomputers**__
